title: Ramatuelle between vineyards, Pampelonne and the Moulin de Paillas
author: Caramagnols
excerpt: Ramatuelle is not limited to its old village. The commune stretches down towards the vineyard plain, the Moulin de Paillas, Pampelonne and a shoreline that changes the scale of the walk completely.
content:
Ramatuelle is often seen through its lanes. Yet the village is only a starting point. As soon as you leave it, the commune opens onto vineyards, slopes, the Moulin de Paillas and the wider spaces of Pampelonne.

The village does not govern the commune alone

The old centre remains essential for understanding Ramatuelle, but the view has to widen quickly. The plain, cultivated land and roads that drop towards the shoreline reveal a commune much larger than its historic core.

The Moulin de Paillas as a relief landmark

The Moulin de Paillas recalls the role of wind, height and older farming patterns. From this sector, it becomes easier to read the relation between the village mound, the peninsula and the openings over the gulf.

Pampelonne changes scale without breaking coherence

The Pampelonne shoreline may seem far from the tight village street, yet it belongs to the same whole. This continuity explains part of Ramatuelle’s character: a territory that is at once rural, maritime and very stretched out.
